lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters organized into vertically aligned columns posterior to the gill region, with horizontal inter-blob spacing roughly equal to blob diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a semi-regular grid of higher-intensity anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a high-luminance leading edge followed by a distinct shadow gradient along the ventral edge of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four high-luminance elongated biological silhouettes (remoras) attached to and trailing the posterior-ventral margin of the right pectoral fin.
